title: Measure standalone stock JBMC on the exact 187 historical claims
description: Run the 187 exception-aware standalone Java targets and their 187 post-call false controls on the original pinned programs. Relocate all classes of the old side on relational claims. Capture every property and replay each reconstructed target failure on a real Temurin JVM, independently against Reference.java where available. Use stock Ubuntu 24.04 JBMC 6.11.0, its packaged core models, full array bound 8, unwind 16 and the 120-second limit.
expected: 187 rows with raw commands, assertion IDs, reach controls, costs and replay disposition. Solver refusal, incomplete unwinding or timeout is a measured outcome.

steps.name: Historical stock targets and false controls
